metadata.note: WS-F and WS-G consolidated outputs were not available at compilation time. Questions assigned to those workstreams are marked PENDING.

questions.text: Nafs typology: Are three states a unified Qur'anic framework or post-Qur'anic Sufi systematization?
questions.summary: Evidence brief prepared with scholarly positions from classical tafsir and Sufi traditions. Architecture impact: affects 3 topics, 7 mappings. Immediate correction identified: 13:28 misclassified under nafs-mutmainna (uses qalb not nafs). Awaiting council decision on typology status.
questions.architectureImpact: Restructure spiritual-states dimension; reassign 7 topic-ayah mappings; update Concept provenance tags

questions.text: Human equality: Split into four propositions or retain as modern category?
questions.summary: WS-G consolidated output not yet available. Question requires scholarly determination of whether modern human-rights framing maps to Qur'anic categories or should be decomposed into fiqh-based sub-topics.
questions.architectureImpact: Potential decomposition of human-equality topic into 4 sub-topics; affects Social & Governance domain

questions.text: Covenant boundary: General ʿahd vs treaty-specific mīthāq topic separation?
questions.summary: WS-G consolidated output not yet available. WS-A notes that peace-agreements topic currently mixes s-l-m and ʿ-h-d roots; separation needed regardless of other decisions.
questions.architectureImpact: Split covenant topic; reassign 5:1 and 16:91 mappings from peace-agreements to covenant topic

questions.text: Hadith-derived topics: Status in Qur'an-centred taxonomy?
questions.summary: WS-G consolidated output not yet available. Intersects with WS-B HadithReport entity design and WS-C phantom CREATE candidates in Hadith & Sunnah cluster (8 topics).
questions.architectureImpact: Determines whether hadith-only topics receive full Topic entities or are modeled as EvidenceRecord annotations

questions.text: Jihād vs Qitāl: Unified or distinct taxonomic treatment?
questions.summary: Evidence brief prepared confirming distinction per MFD-11.3-A. Affects core war-peace taxonomy. Minimum 4 mapping reassignments required. Dimension restructuring needed within war-peace-conflict domain.
questions.architectureImpact: Separate jihad and qital dimensions/topics; reassign ≥4 mappings; update Relationship taxonomy for j-h-d vs q-t-l edges

questions.text: Arts domain: Dissolve or redefine?
questions.summary: Evidence brief confirms dissolution per MFD-11.3-B recommendation. Largest structural change: affects 1 domain, 5 dimensions, ~10 topics, ~30 mappings. Council confirmation required before migration.
questions.architectureImpact: Delete arts-beauty-aesthetics domain; redistribute or deprecate 5 dimensions and ~10 topics; remove ~30 mappings

questions.text: Minor/Major signs: Hadith-derived taxonomy in Qur'an-focused system?
questions.summary: WS-G consolidated output not yet available. Relates to Q4 (hadith-derived topics) and WS-C phantom candidates in Eschatology cluster (8 topics including dajjal-antichrist, end-times-events).
questions.architectureImpact: Determines eschatology topic structure; may require new Subdimension entities under Eschatology dimension

questions.text: Sunnah definition: Post-Qur'anic juristic category vs Qur'anic prophetic authority?
questions.summary: WS-G consolidated output not yet available. Foundational definitional question affecting Hadith & Sunnah topic cluster and WS-B HadithReport integration model.
questions.architectureImpact: Affects Concept definitions for sunnah-related entries; may require separate Concept vs Topic treatment

questions.text: Salām/silm polysemy: Dual mapping or interpretive annotation for 2:208?
questions.summary: Evidence brief prepared. Sets precedent for representing interpretive ambiguity in data model. Cross-cutting with Q11 via 8:61 bridge. Immediate correction: move 5:1 and 16:91 from peace-agreements to covenant topic.
questions.architectureImpact: Establishes polysemy annotation pattern for TopicAyahMapping; single verse decision with model-wide precedent

questions.text: Art-boundaries mappings: Salvageable or fully reclassify?
questions.summary: IMMEDIATE CORRECTION REQUIRED. All 4 art-boundaries mappings (31:6, 17:32, 24:19, 49:11) are demonstrably misclassified. No scholarly position supports current placement. Reclassification can proceed upon council acknowledgment without further deliberation.
questions.architectureImpact: Remove 4 invalid TopicAyahMapping records; reassign verses to correct topics (modesty, backbiting, slander)

questions.text: Ṣulḥ reconciliation: Independent topic or sub-dimension of peace?
questions.summary: Evidence brief prepared. Recommended as independent topic filling identified gap. Moderate effort; cross-domain implications with war-peace-conflict domain. Linked to Q9 via s-l-m root polysemy.
questions.architectureImpact: Create new sulh-reconciliation topic; add EDITORIAL_CLASSIFICATION edge to peace dimension; link to relevant verse mappings

questions.text: Root assignment authority: Classical lexicons vs computational morphology when they disagree?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. Foundational epistemological question for lexical layer. Affects 649 root entries and dispute resolution protocol.
questions.architectureImpact: Determines RootAnalysis.disputeResolution field semantics; affects all morphological analysis downstream

questions.text: Coverage threshold: What minimum percentage is acceptable for scholarly publication?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. Current coverage ~65% mapping rate. Scholarly council must define acceptable threshold for public release.
questions.architectureImpact: Defines release gate metric; no schema change but affects publication workflow gates

questions.text: Morphological granularity: Root only vs full parsed morphology?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. MFD-11.5 found 476 undetermined patterns, no prefix/suffix parsing. Decision determines scope of MorphologicalAnalysis entity population.
questions.architectureImpact: If full parsing adopted, significant expansion of MorphologicalAnalysis schema and data population effort

questions.text: Gloss epistemology: Classical tafsir vs modern linguistic semantics when they diverge?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. MFD-11.5 found 98.6% glosses fail four-layer rubric. Epistemological priority decision required before gloss revision campaign.
questions.architectureImpact: Determines Gloss.provenance weighting and display ordering; affects 640 flagged gloss entries

questions.text: Index scope: Curated thematic lexicon confirmed; exhaustive coverage deferred?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. MFD-11.5 confirmed curated scope but scholarly ratification pending.
questions.architectureImpact: Confirms LexicalEntry inclusion criteria; affects future expansion roadmap

questions.text: Transliteration standard: ISO 233-2 adopted; search aliases separate?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. MFD-11.5 adopted ISO 233-2 but 37.8% violations remain. Scholarly confirmation of standard and alias strategy needed.
questions.architectureImpact: Finalizes transliteration migration spec; affects 245 terms needing correction

questions.text: Polysemy handling: One entry with contextual senses as default?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. Relates to Q9 (salām/silm) precedent. Determines whether polysemous roots get single LexicalEntry with multiple Sense objects or separate entries.
questions.architectureImpact: Affects LexicalEntry schema structure and sense-disambiguation UI design

questions.text: Root disagreements: Preserve competing analyses without forcing resolution?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. MFD-11.5 identified 8 disagreement groups. Policy needed for representing legitimate scholarly differences.
questions.architectureImpact: Confirms DisagreementSet modeling in RootAnalysis; affects display of competing morphological interpretations

questions.text: Morphology null values: Acceptable representation of insufficient evidence?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. MFD-11.5 found 429 null morphology entries correctly representing insufficient evidence. Scholarly confirmation of null-as-valid needed.
questions.architectureImpact: Validates current MorphologicalAnalysis nullable fields; no schema change if confirmed

questions.text: 235 systemic slug defects: Scholarly verification of corrections?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. MFD-11.5 discovered 235 slug defects. Corrections proposed but require scholarly verification before application.
questions.architectureImpact: Batch slug correction script ready; blocked on scholarly sign-off

questions.text: 23 duplicate groups: Genuine polysemy vs extraction artifacts?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. MFD-11.5 adjudicated 23 groups but scholarly confirmation of polysemy vs artifact classification pending.
questions.architectureImpact: Determines merge vs retain decisions for 23 lexical entry groups

questions.text: 640 gloss revisions: Prioritization order for scholarly authoring?
questions.summary: WS-F consolidated output not yet available. MFD-11.5 flagged 640 glosses failing rubric. Prioritization framework needed to sequence scholarly authoring effort.
questions.architectureImpact: No schema change; defines content production roadmap and resource allocation

questions.text: Subdimension entity: Embedded in Dimension or first-class?
questions.summary: Elevated to first-class entity with subdim-{slug} ID format. Schema defined. Migration plan amended to transform 25 existing subdimension records. Cross-reference integrity rules specified.
questions.architectureImpact: New Subdimension entity; modified Dimension and Topic schemas; 4 new integrity rules; migration Phase 2 amended

questions.text: Translation granularity: Per-verse only or per-word interlinear?
questions.summary: Separate WordTranslation entity defined with composite ID encoding edition + token position. SCHEMA ONLY — population deferred until corpus sourcing and licensing clearance.
questions.architectureImpact: New WordTranslation entity (schema ready, data deferred); 3 new integrity rules; no immediate migration

questions.text: Hadith integration: Dedicated entity or Source.type sufficient?
questions.summary: Dedicated HadithReport entity designed with matn, isnād summary, multi-scholar grading. EvidenceRecord references via hadithReportId. Source remains bibliographic container.
questions.architectureImpact: New HadithReport entity; EvidenceRecord.hadithReportId conditional field; variantOf and parallelReports self-referential relationships

questions.text: Cross-lingual concept alignment across Arabic/English/Urdu?
questions.summary: Hub-and-spoke model with divergence annotation. New CROSS_LINGUAL_VARIANT relationship type for DIVERGENT cases. Concept.crossLingualNotes field added with alignmentConfidence enum.
questions.architectureImpact: Modified Concept schema; new CROSS_LINGUAL_VARIANT relationship type (11th type); migration Phase 4 amended

questions.text: ReviewDecision enforcement mechanism at storage layer?
questions.summary: Three-layer defense-in-depth: application middleware (universal) + DB constraints (SQL) + CRDT merge rules (local-first). Six invariants validated at write time.
questions.architectureImpact: Middleware specification; SQL trigger templates; CRDT merge conflict resolution rules; implementation prerequisites identified

questions.text: LearningPath progress tracking: Separate entity or embedded?
questions.summary: Separate LearningProgress entity with UUID v4 IDs. Local IndexedDB only — never bundled, never synced. Schema defined; implementation deferred to application layer build.
questions.architectureImpact: New LearningProgress entity (local-only); 2 new integrity rules; no canonical data migration needed

questions.text: Tanzil proxy rights: Safe-default adequate or more restrictive needed?
questions.summary: Safe default IS adequate BUT NOT CURRENTLY ENFORCED IN PRODUCTION. Immediate enforcement of linkOutOnly:true for rights-unverified + api-import sources required. HIGH SEVERITY legal risk.
questions.architectureImpact: Source.displayConstraints.proxyComplianceMode field added; Edition.proxyEndpoint field added; API middleware enforcement required immediately

questions.text: Audio recording rights: Performer-rights fields needed?
questions.summary: Current model conflates distribution and performer rights. Dual-rights schema extension proposed: recitationRights object with both distributionRightsStatus and performerRightsStatus. Playback gated until both verified.
questions.architectureImpact: Source.recitationRights conditional field added; EvidenceRecord.audioLocator field added; playback gating logic required

questions.text: Community-contributed source verification threshold?
questions.summary: Binary gate insufficient. Four-tier trust model recommended: UNVETTED → BASIC_VERIFIED → RIGHTS_ASSESSED → LEGAL_CLEARED. Human verification required at each tier; no automated promotion.
questions.architectureImpact: Source.trustTier and tierHistory fields added; tier-aware display components needed; ReviewDecision integration for promotions

questions.text: Edition-level rights variance validation against real cases?
questions.summary: Two-level model sound but has enum asymmetry bug and missing derivative-works support. Fixes proposed: rightsOverride enum completion, derivativeOfWork linking, componentRights granularity, computed source rights from editions.
questions.architectureImpact: Edition schema: 4 field additions + 1 enum fix; Source.computedFromEditions indicator; rights computation service needed

questions.text: Reviewer identity credentialing infrastructure?
questions.summary: Standalone ReviewerIdentity entity with scoped authority, domain expertise, authorization chains, and activation lifecycle. Privacy policy prerequisite identified.
questions.architectureImpact: New ReviewerIdentity entity; authorizationChain self-referential relationship; bootstrap governance body charter required before implementation

questions.text: Multi-reviewer quorum for creedal claims?
questions.summary: Category-based quorum tiers (T1–T4). T3 requires 3 approvers from ≥2 traditions for THEOLOGICAL/LEGAL claims. T4 requires all traditions in genuine DisagreementSets.
questions.architectureImpact: ReviewDecision.quorumTier denormalized field; quorum validation middleware; tag system for claim categorization prerequisite

questions.text: Temporal expiry of scholarly approvals?
questions.summary: Per-decision expiry with category defaults: classical = permanent; contemporary = 5–10 years. Re-affirmation via ENDORSE preserves append-only chain.
questions.architectureImpact: ReviewDecision.expiresAt, expiryCategory, reaffirmedCount fields added; expiry engine and notification system prerequisites

questions.text: 243 phantom references: Scholarly determination of which to create vs deprecate?
questions.summary: Full reconciliation completed: 154 CREATE (77%), 2 DEPRECATE (1%), 21 MERGE (10.5%), 23 DEFER (11.5%). 15 high-priority scholarly gaps identified in taxonomy. DEPRECATE candidates are erroneous subdimension-as-topic refs. DEFER candidates require scholarly determination before creation.
questions.architectureImpact: 154 new Topic entities to create; 2 references to remove; 21 merge operations; 23 deferred pending scholarly review; referential integrity checks recommended

questions.text: Implicit CONTAINS edges: Generate from arrays or require explicit authoring?
questions.summary: Generate explicit EDITORIAL_CLASSIFICATION edges from Domain.dimensionIds[], Dimension.subdimensionIds[], and Dimension.topicIds[] arrays during migration. Deterministic ID format: rel-{parentId}-{childId}-EDITORIAL_CLASSIFICATION. Arrays retained for human readability.
questions.architectureImpact: ~500 EDITORIAL_CLASSIFICATION edges generated in migration Phase 3; array-edge consistency rule added to graph integrity rules

questions.text: Urdu/Arabic mojibake in topics.json: UTF-8 normalization pass authorized?
questions.summary: WS-G consolidated output not yet available. Technical remediation likely straightforward but requires scholarly authorization to confirm normalization doesn't alter intended orthography.
questions.architectureImpact: Batch UTF-8 normalization script; no schema change; affects display correctness of Urdu/Arabic titles
